_comment: Repos that receive automatic github-kit bootstrap-file updates via .github/workflows/github-kit-fanout.yml. 'repo' is required. 'base' is optional: the branch the auto-update draft PR targets (a repo's integration branch); when omitted the target's default branch is resolved at run time via the GitHub API. 'install' (optional, default false): a target that does not have the kit installed yet (no docs/ai/PROJECT_CONFIG.md) is skipped with a log line and no PR unless install is true, in which case the full kit is installed on the first run. pzoli6/github-kit itself and pzoli6/app-investment are deliberately not listed (the latter is maintained directly). Add a repo by appending an entry here; nothing is needed on the target side.
